title: Ball Bounce Target
instructions: Drag and rotate deflector blocks to bounce the ball across obstacles directly into the target basket.
description: Ball Bounce Target is an engaging physics puzzle game where precision and angle calculation are key. Arrange deflector blocks on a blueprint grid, preview the parabolic trajectory, and launch the bouncy ball to achieve ricochet shots into the basket across varied visual themes and challenging levels.

faqs.q: How do I play Ball Bounce Target?
faqs.a: Drag deflector planks into position and rotate them by their handles to guide the ball's ricochet bounce toward the target basket.

faqs.q: Can I rotate the deflector blocks?
faqs.a: Yes! Drag the circular rotation handle on selected blocks or use the rotation buttons to adjust angles in fine steps.

faqs.q: Does this game work on mobile and tablet?
faqs.a: Yes, it is fully responsive with intuitive touch controls, high-DPR rendering, and adaptive mobile HUD.
